data.long_meaning: From the Old Czech word 'frant', meaning 'free' or 'frank'. The name Frantisek is a combination of the words 'frant' and 'seka' which mean 'man' or 'lord'. The name Frantisek carries the meaning “Freeman, Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Frantisek usually hope their child will grow to embody freeman, free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
